sections.title: 1. Acceptance of terms
sections.body: By creating an account or using the LOGITERRE application, you fully accept these terms and conditions of use. If you do not accept these terms, please do not use the application.

sections.title: 2. Purpose of the service
sections.body: LOGITERRE is a QR badge networking tool intended for exhibitors and visitors of the Logiterre Expo event. It allows you to scan badges to establish professional connections, browse the exhibitor directory, and manage the members of a booth team.

sections.title: 3. User account
sections.body: You are responsible for the confidentiality of your login credentials and for any activity carried out from your account. You agree to provide accurate information when registering and to keep it up to date.

sections.title: 4. Personal data
sections.body: The data collected (name, email, company, participation type, scan history) is used only within the scope of the application and the Logiterre Expo event. It is not resold to third parties. You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your data at any time from the event organizer, in accordance with the GDPR.

sections.title: 5. Badge scanning and consent
sections.body: By scanning another participant's badge, you create a connection visible in your networking history. Each participant is deemed to have consented to their badge being scanned by other participants as part of the event.

sections.title: 6. Acceptable use
sections.body: You agree to use the application only for legitimate professional purposes related to the event, not to attempt to access accounts or data that do not belong to you, and not to disrupt the operation of the service.

sections.title: 7. Intellectual property
sections.body: All elements of the application (the LOGITERRE brand, interface, content, logos) are protected and may not be reproduced without prior authorization.

sections.title: 8. Limitation of liability
sections.body: LOGITERRE is provided "as is". The publisher cannot be held responsible for service interruptions, data loss, or indirect damages resulting from the use of the application, to the extent permitted by law.

sections.title: 9. Changes to the terms
sections.body: These terms may be updated at any time. Users will be informed of any substantial change through the application. Continued use of the service constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

sections.title: 10. Contact
sections.body: For any question regarding these terms or your personal data, contact the Logiterre Expo organizer through the application's support channels.
